description: Check whether a US employer sponsors green cards (PERM labor certification) and profile their sponsorship, from DOL PERM (Form ETA-9089) disclosures. Answers 'does company X sponsor green cards' for recruiting and candidate advising. Returns the number of certified PERM filings, offered-wage range (min / median / max), the top sponsored job titles, and top worksite locations for the employer. Filter by year (DOL federal fiscal year, Oct-Sep); defaults to the latest full year. Employer name is matched as the disclosed legal name (e.g. 'Microsoft Corporation', 'Amazon.com Services LLC').

employer.description: Employer name to look up, e.g. "Microsoft", "Oracle", "Amazon".

year.description: Filing year (e.g. 2025). Defaults to the most recent full year this pack has data for. Interpreted as DOL federal fiscal year (Oct-Sep).

name: perm_employer_certifications
title: Perm Employer Certifications
